hero.subheadline: A self service music machine for modern bars. Guests choose songs, pay directly on the machine. 25,000+ tracks. Zero hassle.

productIntro.subtitle: SVANDA is a vending machine style entertainment box built for bars and venues. It lives in the corner and earns money around the clock.

karaokeJukebox.title: Karaoke & Jukebox in One
karaokeJukebox.description: No separate setups. One sleek machine handles both karaoke nights and ambient music on demand.

selfService.title: Guests Pay Per Song
selfService.description: Customers browse, choose and pay directly on the machine. Typically 10 CZK per song. No staff needed.

catalogue.title: 25,000+ Songs
catalogue.description: From pop to rock, hip hop to classics. An ever growing catalogue that covers every crowd and every mood.

revenue.title: Passive Venue Revenue
revenue.description: Every song played generates income. The machine works for your venue 24/7, even during quiet hours.

howItWorks.subtitle: The whole experience takes seconds. No apps, no accounts, no waiting. Just walk up, choose, and play.

browse.title: Browse the Catalogue
browse.description: Guests walk up to the machine and search from 25,000+ songs directly on the touchscreen.

pay.title: Pay on the Machine
pay.description: One tap to pay. The integrated payment terminal accepts cards and contactless payments.

play.title: Sing or Play
play.description: The song plays through the system as karaoke with lyrics, or as music for the whole bar.

socialProof.subtitle: The first SVANDA installation is running at Lemon Music Bar with real guests, real songs, and real results every night.
socialProof.quote: "SVANDA completely changed our bar nights. Guests queue up to use it. The machine basically runs itself and earns us money while we focus on service."

whyVenues.subtitle: Everything your venue needs from an entertainment system and nothing it doesn't.

twoInOne.title: Karaoke + Jukebox in One
twoInOne.description: Replace two separate systems with one sleek machine. Karaoke nights and music only evenings both handled.

selfService.title: Fully Self Service
selfService.description: No dedicated staff needed. Guests interact, pay, and enjoy completely independently.

affordable.title: Affordable for Venues
affordable.description: Low upfront cost and simple installation. No complex setup, no monthly software surprises.

revenue.title: Per Song Revenue
revenue.description: Every song played generates direct income. The machine pays for itself and keeps earning.

catalogue.title: 25,000+ Song Catalogue
catalogue.description: Pop, rock, hip hop, folk, classics. Something for every guest, every night.

presence.title: Eye Catching Presence
presence.description: The machine is a visual statement in your venue. Guests notice it, approach it, and come back for it.

showcase.subtitle: A physical machine that looks as good as it performs. Click the hotspots to explore its features.

screen.label: Touchscreen Interface
screen.description: Large HD touchscreen for browsing the full song catalogue.

payment.label: Payment Terminal
payment.description: Contactless and card payments. No cash needed.

speaker.label: Audio Output
speaker.description: Connects directly to your venue sound system.

contact.subtitle: Fill in the form and we'll get back to you within one business day. We'll handle the full setup and you just enjoy the results.
contact.promise: We respond to every inquiry. If you're a bar or venue owner curious about SVANDA we want to hear from you.
